name: Desmond Hall
source:
If there's a target, then Desmond can hit it. Doesn't matter how fast or how far, as the Ultimate Marksman, Desmond can land his shots with whatever ranged weapon of his choice. Favoring the bow, his precision is feared in competition, and is only contrasted by upbeat demeanour towards helping his friends accomplish their goals as well.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1349846885360676866]official source[/url]]
